description: ta86_paintit – LoRA Description ta86_paintit was created to enhance controlled, high quality painterly images and mixed media. The focus lies on traditional artistic mediums, expressive brushwork and layered material textures rather than photorealistic rendering. The LoRA encourages images that feel intentionally painted or drawn, with natural pigment behavior and handcrafted visual structure. ta86_paintit is a painterly rendering LoRA that enahnces characters, environments and objects into images that resemble traditional artworks created with watercolor, oil paint, colored pencil and mixed media techniques. The goal is a clean artistic presence where materials behave like real paint, pigment and drawing tools instead of digital effects. ZIT is a distilled checkpoint. If you prompt for a whole other style, you will get a whole other style. It's not toasted. Style features Traditional painting structure Visible brush strokes, layered pigments and painterly surface variation. Watercolor behavior Soft pigment diffusion, translucent color layers, organic edge transitions. Oil paint texture Rich color depth, thicker brush marks, tactile surface structure. Colored pencil detailing Fine line definition, delicate shading, subtle hand drawn structure. Material driven rendering Pigments behave like real paint on paper or canvas. Balanced artistic composition Calm framing, intentional subject placement, painterly visual rhythm. Natural pigment palette Earth tones, botanical hues, mineral pigments, subtle saturation. Illustrative realism balance Realistic forms with artistic interpretation and texture. Best used for Painterly character portraits Illustrated fantasy scenes Traditional art inspired environments Storybook style illustrations Fine art compositions Painterly concept art Mixed media visual storytelling Atmospheric painted landscapes Tips Use the trigger word ta86_paintit for consistent results. LoRA strength 0.4 to 1.0 Recommended: 0.6 to 0.85 Lower values preserve more base checkpoint structure. Higher values increase painterly texture and pigment presence. Let brushwork and pigment structure guide the image. Main trigger Not needed.
